decisions.reason: Although management has some sunk-cost and self-justification pressure after backing it before, the product has low recent visibility and is less central to the firm's infrastructure-led direction, making withdrawal to refocus resources more likely.

This offer remains tightly aligned with the firm's owned metro, data-centre and cloud-connectivity strengths, and prior visible adoption supports continued commitment despite limited recent website visibility.

Optical spectrum connectivity fits the firm's high-bandwidth fibre strategy and earlier dedicated promotion creates commitment, so management is likely to retain it unless it is merely folded into a broader portfolio.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service with weak fit to the firm's stated move toward software-defined integrated infrastructure, and after years of low visibility it is the clearest candidate to discontinue.
